checks: Public API created a disposable shell Agent and isolated workspace.
WebSocket input executed and produced a unique marker rather than matching terminal echo.
Output produced while disconnected was replayed on reconnect without changing runner generation.
Stop/resume replaced the runner and preserved the original workspace canary.
An operator fixture changed only the stopped test Sandbox; its next Pod really exited with code zero and restartPolicy Never.
The control plane suspended and resumed the completed Pod automatically; the following Pod ran the real runner.
The workspace PVC UID and canary survived the completed-Pod recovery.
Deletion removed the disposable Agent, claim, Sandbox, Pod, and PVC.
Both preexisting Codex Agents still reported running after the rollout and test.
limitations: This test covers the shared shell/lifecycle infrastructure, not model inference or credential revocation.
Resource budget enforcement and automatic idle stopping remain outstanding.
